thread:
alex: kicking off canary for payments-service helm chart v4.2.0 in eu-west with an override: featureX=true, db.schemaVersion=2

deploy-bot: Canary started (id=cyn-472). Target: eu-west. 10 -> 20 pods, traffic 5% -> 20%. Preflight checks running.

maya: getting a preflight warning in the logs — values schema validation failed: field 'db.schemaVersion' type mismatch (expected string)

sam: oof. is that a chart change in 4.2.0?

alex: yep — chart bumped to stricter CRD/values validation. our override used an int here historically, chart now expects string. quick paths: patch the values to "\"2\"" or pin to last known-good chart (v4.1.9) for eu-west. given change window and customer traffic, leaning pin.

jen: +1 to pin. less blast radius and we can assemble release notes explaining the validation tightening.

deploy-bot: ALERT: post-deploy hook timeout detected for canary cyn-472. Canary paused automatically.

maya: I'll draft the release note snippet and include the migration step (stringify schema field) so customers know the required change.

sam: if we pin, what's the helm command to force that region only? can we do a region-scoped promotion?

alex: we'll do a targeted release using the deploy bot override (region=eu-west) and set chart:v4.1.9. Manual steps if needed:

```bash
# force a scoped release to eu-west namespace/payment
helm upgrade payments-service redwood/payments --version 4.1.9 --values eu-west-overrides.yaml --namespace payments --wait
# or rollback if the canary staged pods misbehave\helm rollback payments-service 1 --namespace payments
```

jen: I'll request the deploy-bot manual override in the release channel and attach release-note draft. Change window for this tenant is 22:00-02:00 UTC, we should schedule the pin there.

sre-oncall: I'll watch the cluster and keep an eye on pod churn, ready to intervene if the pinned chart shows a regression.

deploy-bot: Manual override request acknowledged (ticket: OV-8321). Pending approver: @jen.

alex: decision: abort the current canary (cyn-472), pin eu-west to 4.1.9 during the change window, assemble release notes that call out the values schema tightening and provide the migration snippet. We'll revisit promoting 4.2.0 after a compat patch or opt-in flag.

maya: copy — adding migration snippet to the release notes and creating a short eval to validate values parsing across tenants.

sam: cheers. leaving a quick note: if anyone runs into hook timeouts, check job:payments-migrate-hook logs and restart the hook job if stuck.

jen: approved override, deploy-bot will schedule pin at 22:05 UTC in the change window. I'll post final release-note and a follow-up thread once done. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Override scheduled. Pin action will run at 167% of the window start (scheduled at 22:05 UTC). Will post status here when complete.

sre-oncall: I'll be on standby for the 22:00->23:00 watch.

alex: thanks everyone — keeping notes in the release doc and tagging this thread for audit.
